lines.en: I walk sideways; sideways is faster.
Both claws held out in front.

lines.zh: 我踩在湿沙上，留下小孔
lines.en: I leave small holes in the wet sand.
I scuttle sideways along the tideline.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有细碎的响声
lines.en: Small clicks follow my steps.
I pause at a stone and go around.
My legs move one by one, quickly.

lines.zh: 我从沙里出来，壳上带沙粒
lines.en: I come out of the sand, grit on my shell.
I smell water and head for it.
I scuttle across a shallow pool.
I walk backward, eyes still forward.
I bump a stem and go around.
A bit of seaweed clings to my shell.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但方向很准
lines.en: I am not fast, but my direction is sure.
I scuttle behind the stone.
I pace sideways at the water's edge.
I stand, claws half raised.

lines.zh: 我的壳是浅色的，沾了泥
lines.en: My shell is pale, mud on it.
I listen to the water.

lines.zh: 我把螯合了一下，发出轻响
lines.en: I click my claws once.
I have barely any life in me; I am small.
Something moves in the sand.
I hold sideways and still.
My eyes are on stalks; they turn.
The tide has drawn back a little.
There is food in this patch.
The sun has heated my shell.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，躲进影子
lines.en: I lower myself into the shade.
I wait for the water to rise.
I raise one claw to measure.
I lift my eye stalks to you.
You are far bigger than this stone.
I scuttle half a step aside.
I mean no harm; I am too small.
My claws are up, but I want to run.

lines.zh: 我的螯举起来，其实夹不疼
lines.en: My claws are raised, but they barely pinch.
I tuck my claws under my shell.
There is a way out by your foot.

lines.zh: 我憋着不动，连眼柄都收。
lines.en: I freeze, even my eye stalks folded in.
Try to catch me; I run fast sideways.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，挣扎着起来
lines.en: I flip over and struggle up.
That nearly crushed me.
I cannot cry out; I can only wave my claws.

lines.zh: 我的壳上又添一道白缝。
lines.en: Another pale crack joins the shell.
I scuttle far away.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了一条，还能走
lines.en: One leg gone; I can still walk.
I scuttle sideways into the crack.
I have only this much life.
My claws are raised, and trembling.
You stepped too hard.
Can this be eaten?
I edge sideways a little closer.
If you grab with claws, you will break it.
I pinch it with a claw.
That is enough.
I retreat into the sand to eat.

lines.zh: 你放低一点我才够得着
lines.en: Lower it and I can reach.
This smells strongly of fish.
I hold it and will not let go.
I pinched this scrap of fish first.
You step down; I dart sideways.
Too small; the bump flips me.
I flip over, then flip back.
I flip over and my legs scrabble.
That pushed me into the water.
I raise a claw to block.

lines.zh: 我没有退路，只能横着跑
lines.en: No way back; I can only run sideways.
A pit is pressed into the sand.
I shake the sand off.
I hide in a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我们互相举着螯，横着绕
lines.en: We circle sideways, claws raised.
There are plenty of small crabs here.

lines.zh: 我横着靠近，她也横着靠近
lines.en: I sidle close; she sidles close.
We do not fight; we only compare size.
A hole in the sand is enough.
The tide will look after the eggs.
Two of us scuttling is quick.
Our shells are much the same color.
She is a little larger; I do not argue.
This beach is enough for us.
I pinch it and lift it.
It is bigger than my shell.
My grip fails; it drops.
I drag it to the burrow mouth.
This is too slippery.
I use both claws.
I run sideways with it held.
I set it on the sand and nibble.
I need only a little.
I bury it in the sand.
Something stirs under the sand.
I scuttle that way.
If I can eat it, I eat it.
I chase the small, not the large.
Very close; two scuttles away.
I raise both claws.
It looks smaller than me.
Things at the water's edge are easiest.
I move to its flank.
I am going in.
I follow it sideways.
It backs into the water; I dare not follow.
I go behind the stone.
I make no sound; my steps are tiny.
Its shadow wavers in the water.
I sidle a little closer.
My claws are already open.
I edge sideways with my shell low.
This is a good spot.
I moved forward once.
I raise a claw and snap.
That pinch was not heavy.

lines.zh: 我的螯太小，只能夹住皮
lines.en: My claws are small; they only catch skin.
I snap again.
It shakes me off; I climb back on.
I scuttle sideways away.
I clamp and hold.

lines.zh: 这一下的力气，全在螯上
lines.en: All my strength is in the claws.
I am too small to be an opponent.
I retreat into the sand.

lines.zh: 沙上多了一个小小的影子
lines.en: A small shadow appears on the sand.
I crawl out beside a sand hole.
It is damp here, and there is food.

lines.zh: 我很少的一点血，要小心
lines.en: So little life in me; I must be careful.

lines.zh: 海风把我的味道吹散了
lines.en: The sea wind scatters my scent.
I crawl out from between the grains.

lines.zh: 潮水刚退，地上都是新的
lines.en: The tide just went out; everything is new.

lines.zh: 我挑了一块有阴影的石头
lines.en: I pick a stone with shade.
My shell is not fully hardened.
I lift my eyes and look around.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我横着窜进水里
lines.en: Fire comes near; I dart into the water.

lines.zh: 我从石头上掉下去，壳磕响了
lines.en: I fall off the stone; my shell knocks.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的壳，我拼命划
lines.en: Water covers my shell; I paddle hard.
The blast wave throws me off the ground.

lines.zh: 一支箭从我壳边擦过去
lines.en: An arrow grazes past my shell.
A force pins me to the sand.
Nothing left on this sand.
A flash of lightning and I burrow into the sand.
No sand beneath me.
